title: Touch targets and drag alternatives
focus: Audit remaining actual target/spacing and single-pointer non-drag alternatives. Add focused evidence or patches for uncovered flows; keep physical-device and emulation evidence distinct.

originalChecklistStatements.A-D-12: - [ ] A-D-12 Reconcile original `D-12`: Make important touch controls comfortably operable; density must not erase minimum hit areas or keyboard focus indicators. Historical status: open.
originalChecklistStatements.A-U-17: - [ ] A-U-17 Reconcile original `U-17`: Provide consistent focus ring, target size, disabled styling, validation, status announcement, and pointer/keyboard interactions across primitives. Historical status: open.
originalChecklistStatements.A-X-07: - [ ] A-X-07 Reconcile original `X-07`: Verify target size/spacing against WCAG requirements and aim for comfortable primary touch targets; test coarse-pointer use rather than shrinking every hit area with density. Historical status: open.
originalChecklistStatements.A-X-08: - [ ] A-X-08 Reconcile original `X-08`: Provide both keyboard and single-pointer non-drag alternatives for drag operations where required; keyboard support alone does not satisfy every dragging requirement. Historical status: open.
